title: bug: the CQ-V08 finalize deferral keys on the pinned profile while strong landings key on strong_landing_task, so a strong journal under a non-verified-local pin finalizes before its receipt
description: finalize_postflight (moe-agent.sh) and Complete-MoePostflight (moe-agent.ps1) defer only when PINNED_ATTEMPT_PROFILE / $script:PinnedAttemptProfile is verified-local, and their CQ-V08b journal removal has the same condition. strong_landing_task / Test-MoeStrongLandingTask, which decide the check-VM route and the strong journal, also return true from the newest attempt record or a leftover strong receipt journal of the task. With a leftover strong journal and an observe pin, a worktree landing writes a strong journal, and an unacknowledged receipt then finalizes landed anyway; the receipt only lands at the next replay. A narrow mixed-profile case found by task-527735ea's self-review. A fix would key both conditions on the journal's own profile (or strong_landing_task).

implementationPlan.description:
moe-agent.sh and its harness rows, rows first.
Before editing, re-read the landed bytes of both dependencies, CQ-M07t (task-527735ea) and task-a1f3723f:
- in scripts/moe-agent.sh: finalize_postflight, wt_land_published, strong_landing_task, receipt_send, and the two lines that reset RECEIPT_ACKED (run_landing's landing-state line and the per-iteration pre-flight reset);
- the [strong receipt] section of scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.sh.
Names here are from CQ-M07t's checkpoint eb09f869; line numbers will drift. If task-a1f3723f rewrote either finalize condition, apply (b) to its version and keep all of its changes. If the bug is already fixed there, write only the rows.

(a) Rows (TDD). In [strong receipt], after SR-T4 and before the closing echo, add the mixed-profile block.
- sr_mixed runs sg_fixture, then writes $PROJECT/.moe/attempts/attempt-tie.json (mkdir -p first) as one line: {"id":"attempt-tie","taskId":"task-postflight","generation":7,"workerId":"worker-old","phase":"closed","executionPolicySnapshot":{"version":2,"profile":"verified-local","planRevision":1}}
  - It ties the fake's attempt-postflight at generation 7, and strong_landing_task counts a tie as strong (fail closed).
  - Being closed, it is skipped by moe_attempt_read, wt_open_attempts and moe_seat_finalizing_attempts.
- SR_MIXED=(FAKE_ATTEMPT_PROFILE=observe MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH="$SG_FAKE") is the observe pin.
- The rows run with VMR_SETUP=sr_mixed:
  - SR-M1: "${SR_MIXED[@]}" FAKE_CHECK_DISPATCH=pass FAKE_EVIDENCE_MODE=receipt-refused, then sr_check SR-M1 deferred.
  - Copy $PROJECT to $TMP_DIR/sr-keep, as T2 does. With VMR_SETUP=sr_restore, run SR-M1-replay: "${SR_MIXED[@]}" FAKE_CLAIM_MODE=finalizing. Then set VMR_SETUP=sr_mixed and run sr_check SR-M1-replay replay.
  - SR-M2: "${SR_MIXED[@]}" FAKE_CHECK_DISPATCH=pass, then sr_check SR-M2 pass.
  - Finish with VMR_SETUP=sg_fixture.
- One echo line names the block. The closing line becomes '[strong receipt] ok T1, T2, T2-replay, T3, T4, M1, M1-replay, M2'.
- sr_check is reused unchanged: its deferred, replay and pass kinds already assert every effect of this bug.

Record the red on the UNFIXED wrapper:
- SR-M1 fails at 'finalized before the receipt was recorded'.
- In a scratch copy without the M1 rows, SR-M2 fails at 'the receipt journal stayed'.
- Any other failure means the fixture is wrong.
A full postflight-vm-route.sh takes about 6 min. A slice built like sg-only.sh in mem:gotcha-sliced-driver-exit-trap-masks-wiring (the preamble, the [strong gate] fixture lines, then this section) iterates faster.

(b) Fix, in finalize_postflight.
- Beside 'local outcome=failed', add 'local strong=""'. Set strong=1 when PINNED_ATTEMPT_PROFILE is verified-local or RECEIPT_STRONG is true.
- Replace the [ "${PINNED_ATTEMPT_PROFILE:-}" = verified-local ] test with [ -n "$strong" ] in exactly two places, the CQ-V08 deferral if and the CQ-V08b removal if. Change nothing else in those conditions.
- In wt_land_published's strong branch: RECEIPT_JOURNAL="$3"; RECEIPT_ACKED=""; RECEIPT_STRONG=true.
- Append RECEIPT_STRONG="" to both lines that reset RECEIPT_ACKED.
- Update one comment line each in CQ-V08, CQ-V08b and wt_land_published's header. The strong landing is the pin or, under any pin, a worktree landing whose own journal is strong, because strong_landing_task also journals strong from an attempt record or a leftover journal.
- Add no new printed string, code or exported variable.
Error handling stays as it is:
- A journal that is missing or cannot be parsed never sets the flag: wt_land_published's read already falls back to the legacy branch.
- A lost finalize_attempt keeps today's path: MOE_FINALIZE_RC=1, and the journal is kept for the replay.
The rows then pass.

The moe-agent.ps1 twin, rows first. Re-read the landed bytes first:
- Complete-MoePostflight, Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding, Test-MoeStrongLandingTask and Send-MoeReceipt;
- Invoke-SrRows and Assert-SrRow in postflight-vm-route.ps1.
Apply step 1's rule to task-a1f3723f's changes.

(a) Rows. In Invoke-SrRows, after SR-T4 and before its closing Write-Host:
- $mixed = @{ FAKE_ATTEMPT_PROFILE = 'observe'; MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH = $sgFake; FAKE_CHECK_DISPATCH = 'pass' }.
- A setup scriptblock runs Initialize-SgFixture, then writes $project\.moe\attempts\attempt-tie.json (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force first) with [IO.File]::WriteAllText and step 1's exact JSON line.
- Run the rows inside try/finally, so $script:VmrSetup always returns to { Initialize-SgFixture }:
  - SR-M1: $mixed + @{ FAKE_EVIDENCE_MODE = 'receipt-refused' }, then Assert-SrRow deferred.
  - Copy $project to its own keep dir, as T2 does. Run SR-M1-replay from it with @{ FAKE_ATTEMPT_PROFILE = 'observe'; MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH = $sgFake; FAKE_CLAIM_MODE = 'finalizing' }, then Assert-SrRow replay.
  - SR-M2: $mixed, then Assert-SrRow pass.
- The closing line becomes '[strong receipt] ok T1, T2, T2-replay, T3, T4, M1, M1-replay, M2'.
- Mind mem:gotcha-ps1-harness-syntax-traps. Names are case-insensitive, so give each scriptblock and keep path its own name.

Red on the unfixed wrapper:
- SR-M1 fails with 'receipts 1, finalizes 1, phase closed, ...'.
- SR-M2 fails with 'phase closed, the journal stayed, or a deferral or kept line'.
Run it on both engines from a /mnt/d cwd, with MOE_*, CLAUDE* and FAKE_* scrubbed (mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl). Run 5.1 as pwsh.exe -nop -c "cmd /c powershell -nop -ep Bypass -f postflight-vm-route.ps1" (mem:decision-mid-epic-launcher-gate-narrow).

(b) Fix.
- In Complete-MoePostflight, right after $r=$script:MoeLandingResult, add:
  $strong = $script:PinnedAttemptProfile -ceq 'verified-local' -or ($null -ne $r -and $r.ReceiptStrong -eq $true)
- Then replace $script:PinnedAttemptProfile -ceq 'verified-local' with $strong in exactly the CQ-V08 deferral if and the CQ-V08b removal if.
- In Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding's strong branch, add $Res.ReceiptStrong = $true beside $Res.ReceiptJournal = $Journal; $Res.ReceiptAcked = $false.
  - $Res is the landing result, a fresh hashtable per landing.
  - $script:MoeLandingResult is reset to $null every iteration, so no reset is needed.
- Make the comments and Twin notes match sh.
Error handling: if the journal read or ConvertFrom-Json throws, the existing catch sets $ok=$false and leaves $strong false, so the flag stays unset. Add no new printed string.
The rows then pass on 5.1 and 7.

Verification: run checkRefs[0] exactly, once, after steps 1 and 2.
- Save it byte-for-byte to a scratch file outside the checkout, e.g. /mnt/d/moe-scratch/<dir>/gate.sh.
- Start it detached: nohup bash -c 'bash gate.sh > out.txt 2>&1; echo CHAIN_EXIT=$? >> out.txt' &
- Record $! and poll with timeout 540 bash -c 'until grep -q ^CHAIN_EXIT= out.txt; do sleep 15; done'.
- Never run it in a shell you reuse: it unsets MOE_*.
The architect's dry run of this exact command on eb09f869 (no new rows yet) gave CHAIN_EXIT=0 in 643 s (10.7 min) at load 4-10, with every leg's suites green (logs: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/tedf2/logs). Expect 1-2 min more.

What the gate covers:
- postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1} on bash, 5.1 and 7;
- worktree-landing.{sh,ps1};
- postflight.{sh,ps1}, limited by MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY to three shared-mode modes: intent-strong, receipt-refused and reconcile-strong-receipt-lost. They pin the unchanged pinned-profile deferral and removal, and a legacy journal that never defers.
- postflight-worktree.cjs wt-completion and wt-replay (sh);
- parity-check.{sh,ps1}, npm run lint, bash -n and ParseFile.
The gate exits 0 only with an '@' from every leg and 'PASS frozen candidate scenarios: 3' in each log, so a renamed frozen mode fails it.

Error handling for a red run:
- A leg whose log holds only a WSL 'UtilAcceptVsock' error never ran: rerun the whole gate.
- For a red row, first rerun the parent revision's scripts (mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl). Then fix and rerun the whole command, never just one leg.
Submit this command, its exit code and the tail as complete_task's verification. Not run here: the full postflight.sh and .ps1 suites. They belong to the nightly (the 20-min rail).

Adversarial self-review of the task diff, before complete_task. Use git diff against the task base.
(1) Scope. Only these change: the two conditions in each finalize, the flag in each strong branch, the two sh resets, comments, and the new rows. Every other PINNED_ATTEMPT_PROFILE / PinnedAttemptProfile test stays pin-keyed:
- land_plumbing's strong path and its stale-journal refusal;
- the Record block's proof check;
- the pull --rebase refusal;
- receipt_report;
- their ps1 twins.
The shared mode writes a strong journal only under the pin.
(2) The flag.
- It is set only where the journal's own profile is verified-local, and reset with RECEIPT_ACKED. It is never exported.
- It only ever adds a hold, or drops the landing's own journal after its attempt is closed. It never grants anything.
(3) Mutants. Run each on a scratch copy, never in W. Each must turn red:
- M-a: drop the RECEIPT_STRONG / ReceiptStrong arm. SR-M1 and SR-M2 go red.
- M-b: drop the pin arm. Frozen reconcile-strong-receipt-lost (the deferral) and intent-strong (the journal removal) go red.
- M-c: key on a set RECEIPT_JOURNAL / ReceiptJournal instead of the flag. Frozen receipt-refused goes red (its finalize count must be 1).
On sh, MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY runs in about 15 s. On ps1 it takes about 25 s per engine.
(4) Edges.
- Twice or concurrently: finalize is memoized, and the land lease and owner guard serialize one task.
- Empty or unset flag: not strong.
- Residual, and pre-existing under the pin: wt_land_rounds' recovered path (LAND_WT_RECOVERED) hands wt_land_published a leftover journal whose attemptId may name an earlier attempt, and the replay finalizes only the journal's attempt. Check whether a non-strong pin can reach it. If it can, file a bug row instead of widening this task.
Put the red/green evidence, the mutant results and a DoD map in the completion summary.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
Both wrappers treat a worktree landing whose own receipt journal is strong (profile verified-local) as a strong landing at finalize, whatever this session's pinned profile.
- An unacknowledged delivery receipt then defers finalize_attempt (MOE_FINALIZE_DEFERRED_RECEIPT). The attempt stays finalizing, and the journal is kept for the pre-flight replay, which records the receipt and then finalizes.
- Once the attempt is closed, the journal is dropped (CQ-V08b).
The key is the landing's own flag: RECEIPT_STRONG in sh, ReceiptStrong in ps1. wt_land_published and Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding set it exactly where they already read the journal's profile to send the receipt.
Unchanged:
- sessions pinned verified-local;
- legacy and observe landings with no strong journal, legacy-gate shared journals included.
acceptanceCriteria: finalize_postflight (sh) and Complete-MoePostflight (ps1) test strong = pinned verified-local OR the landing's strong-journal flag, in both the CQ-V08 deferral and the CQ-V08b journal removal. The rest of each condition is unchanged.

wt_land_published and Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding set the flag only in their strong branch, where the journal's own profile is verified-local. sh resets RECEIPT_STRONG at both sites that reset RECEIPT_ACKED. ps1 needs no reset: its landing result is a fresh hashtable.

New [strong receipt] rows SR-M1 (deferred), SR-M1-replay (replay) and SR-M2 (pass) in postflight-vm-route.sh and .ps1 run under an observe pin with a tied verified-local attempt record, and reuse sr_check / Assert-SrRow unchanged. On the unfixed wrapper they fail at the bug: 'finalized before the receipt was recorded', 'the receipt journal stayed' and the ps1 equivalents. On the fix they pass on bash, 5.1 and 7.

Every existing row stays green unedited: [strong receipt] T1-T4 and T2-replay, [strong gate], the other vm-route sections, worktree-landing.{sh,ps1}, and the frozen modes intent-strong, receipt-refused and reconcile-strong-receipt-lost.
checkRefs[0] exits 0, with an @ marker from all three legs and 'PASS frozen candidate scenarios: 3' in each log.
Mutants M-a (no flag arm), M-b (no pin arm) and M-c (keyed on a set journal path) each turn a gate row red, as reported in the completion summary.
invariants: A session pinned verified-local sends the same RPCs, in the same order, as before, in shared and worktree mode.
A legacy or observe landing with no strong journal sends the same RPCs as before. A legacy-gate shared journal never defers.
The flag comes only from the profile field of the journal the wrapper itself wrote or reuses, never from the environment. It is not exported, and it is blanked before every iteration's landing.
The flag only adds a finalize hold, or drops the landing's own journal once its attempt is closed. It never grants readiness, skips a check or sends an RPC.
No new printed string, reason code, setting or env name. parity-check.{sh,ps1} are unchanged and green.
The journal format, receipt_send / Send-MoeReceipt, the pre-flight replay and the daemon are unchanged.
compatibility: Journals written before this change replay as before: the replay keys on the journal's own profile, and this task does not touch it.
MOE_FINALIZE_DEFERRED_RECEIPT and the kept-journal warning lines keep their exact text.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
(1) Re-read RECEIPT_JOURNAL's profile in finalize. Rejected:
  - shared mode keeps a legacy-gate journal at the same path. After a failed best-effort write, a leftover strong journal could sit there and make a legacy landing defer, stranding the attempt, because the replay finalizes only the journal's own attempt;
  - it also adds a JSON parse per finalize.
(2) Key on strong_landing_task. Rejected: it reads every attempt record and the path, so a legacy-gate shared landing could defer. That is a legacy behaviour change, and a glob per finalize.
(3) Replace the pin with the flag. Rejected: the shared strong path never sets the flag, so the pinned shared deferral and removal would break. Frozen modes reconcile-strong-receipt-lost and intent-strong pin this.
Chosen: the pin OR a flag set where wt_land_published / Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding already decide strong from the journal's own profile. It is the description's "journal's own profile", computed once, strictly additive, with no extra IO.
Trigger: the description's literal route, a leftover journal, is deleted before the round when its C never landed, and otherwise goes through the recovered path. The rows use the fail-closed attempt-record tie, which writes a fresh strong journal naming this attempt. SR-M1-replay then proves the deferral is settled by the replay.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- finalize_postflight / Complete-MoePostflight are memoized, and the worktree landing calls them from inside wt_land_published / Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding with signals deferred.
- ps1 $Res is $script:MoeLandingResult, which is set before Complete-MoeWorktreeLanding runs.
- The sh landing-state resets are the run_landing init line and the per-iteration pre-flight line. Both also blank RECEIPT_JOURNAL and RECEIPT_ACKED.
- record_delivery_receipt has no attempt or profile gate. So the next pre-flight replay settles a deferred observe-pinned attempt: it re-sends the receipt, finalizes the journal's attempt while it is finalizing, then drops the strong journal.
- parity-check compares only MOE_* code families and fixed literals; RECEIPT_STRONG is neither.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Strong local delivery" already describes the journal-keyed behaviour, so no docs edit is needed. The epic-final row owns the docs sweep.
